question: From which of the following years did the fourth five-year plan commence?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1969**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Fourth Five-Year Plan in India was launched in **1969** and covered the period from 1969 to 1974.
 
• This plan aimed at achieving self-reliance and growth with stability.
 
• During this period, the emphasis was on improving the conditions of marginalized sections of society and reducing inequalities in income and wealth distribution.
 
• It also focused on enhancing the agricultural sector and increasing the production of food grains to ensure food security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Five-Year Plans in India**

 
 
• The Five-Year Plans were central economic plans formulated by the Planning Commission of India from 1951 to 2017.
 
• The objective was to develop, execute, and monitor economic strategies to promote the economic development of the country.
 
• These plans were inspired by the Soviet model and aimed at achieving rapid industrialization and economic growth.
 
• Each plan focused on different sectors such as agriculture, industry, education, health, and infrastructure development to improve the overall socio-economic conditions of the country.
 
 
 
• **Fourth Five-Year Plan (1969-1974)**
 
 
• The Fourth Plan laid stress on the need for improving the standard of living of the common people of India.
 
• It aimed at achieving a 5.5% growth rate in the national income.
 
• It emphasized the need for better utilization of resources and the importance of technological advancements in the agricultural sector.
 
• The plan also focused on increasing employment opportunities and reducing the disparities in income and wealth.
